Estimates in this table are produced by integrating data from the administrative Postsecondary Student Information System dataset (PSIS) with data from the 2016 Census and the 2021 Census and tax data from the T1 Family File (T1FF) and the Administrative Personal Income Masterfile (APIM). In particular, the population group information is added from the Census of Population 2A-L long-form questionnaire. This information can only be matched to a fraction of PSIS individuals, since the long form covers a sample of the Canadian population. Non-linkage weights have been derived and applied to these estimates in order to be representative of the entire PSIS population. The data and methods are subject to revision. Totals may not add up to the sum of all categories due to rounding.

These estimates include only Canadian students, where Canadian students" include Canadian citizens and permanent residents. The concept of status of student in Canada is defined on December 31st of the year of graduation."
